title: Seeking Purity in Moments of Desire
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غُضَّ بَصَرِي وَ حَصِّنْ فَرْجِي وَ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي
transliteration: Allāhumma ghuḍḍa baṣarī wa ḥaṣṣin farjī wa ṭahhir qalbī.
translation: Oh Allah! Lower my gaze, protect my private parts, and purify my heart!
reference: A general supplication based on Quranic principles (e.g., Surah An-Nur 24:30-31)
